findings.evidence: Authoring now groups (asset derived SHA-256, linear-mask versus srgb-face semantics, width, height), exactly matching native cacheKey constituents. Each unique key contributes width*height once; runtimeRgbaBytes is that total times four. distinctRuntimeFileCount separately counts relative paths. Binding/provenance counts are not deduplicated.

Reversing only the reporting block reproduces the exact original full tool SHA-256 590d08d7c39ca4377e47eca304cc7f75df0224409e33136488e9a211ffdf84ee. Removing only the newly added regression reproduces original full test SHA-256 fa08a304c7c0f0422414c8bb7b3cfbb344abd3d3982ba715ea3b81039de7ff16. Consequently normalization/pixels, recipe, generation identity, inventory/manifest schema and content generation, preflight, locking and manifest-last publication code are unchanged. The additive report field is the intended reporting change. Actual manifest and generation inventory also retain their original review pins.

Authoring validates source pins/dimensions, fully decodes PNGs, compares normalized RGBA arrays, constructs entries from internally derived hashes and rechecks inputs before publication. Native independently validates schema/identity/provenance, reads/path-checks/hash-checks each binding and inspects PNG dimensions; every mask requires its own decoded aligned face BEFORE cache reuse, then unique budget and real decode success gate retention. Report totals describe intended complete supplied-texture resources under successful native admission; they do not assert that default-budget loading admits all entries. runtimeRgbaBytes is uncompressed RGBA32 pixel payload only, not measured native/GPU/process memory, object overhead or foley memory. The fix changes none of these admission rules.
